for url in $urls; do
    filename="$(basename "$url")"
    case "$filename" in
        *.pdf) paper="$filename" ;;
        *) paper="${filename}.pdf" ;;
    esac
    if [ ! -f "$paper" ]; then
        wget -q \
            --retry-connrefused \
            --waitretry=1 \
            --tries=5 \
            --timeout=30 \
            -O "$paper" "$url"
    fi
done

count="$(find /root/papers/all -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)"
if [ "$count" -ne 100 ]; then
    echo "Expected 100 papers, found $count" >&2
    exit 1
fi
mount / from exec /bin/sh -c apt-get update && apt-get install -y     python3     python3-pip     python3-venv     libreoffice     poppler-utils     wget     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
